about.body: The AJ150D is Jaguar Land Rover's 1.5-litre three-cylinder diesel engine, part of the Ingenium family introduced in 2018. It's fitted to the Discovery Sport (L550, 2018–present) and the Range Rover Evoque (L551, 2019–present) — the D150 variant in both models. This is the smallest diesel in the Ingenium lineup, sharing the same base architecture as the AJ200D four-cylinder diesel but with one fewer cylinder. It was introduced as a more efficient entry point for Land Rover's compact SUV range, offering the D150 power output across both applications.

byModel.body: Discovery Sport (L550, D150, 2018–present): The AJ150D is fitted to the Discovery Sport as the D150 variant, serving as the entry-level diesel option in the range. This application is one of the two we work on for this engine.

compatibility.body: Registration/VIN matching is required — the AJ150D is fitted to two distinct models (Discovery Sport L550 and Range Rover Evoque L551), and while the base engine is the same, vehicle-specific ancillaries differ by application. We confirm your exact model and spec before any rebuild or replacement work proceeds. The three-cylinder diesel is a distinct variant within the Ingenium family, different from the four-cylinder AJ200D that appears across a wider range of Land Rover models.
